title: Split test_golden_prompts.py into one file per golden scenario
description: test_golden_prompts.py currently contains all golden test scenarios in a single file. Split each test into its own file (e.g. test_golden_initial_decision.py, test_golden_bolt_on_stack.py, test_golden_clone_copies_memnite.py) so they can be run independently and failures are easier to triage. The shared helpers (run_golden_scenario, _assert_golden_prompt, etc.) should move to a shared module.
